description: Stable agent-readable codes for everything that can stop verify-section-preview from producing a storefront-render artifact. Returned by inspect-bootstrap and verify-section-preview preflight; quoted in section-result.openIssues. agentFixable=true codes MUST be self-remediated by the implementing agent before delivering a section result; only agentFixable=false codes are legitimate `status: "blocked"` reasons.

codes.remediation: make bootstrap-kik-theme (writes the file using the storefront block from harness/config/agent-tools.json).

codes.summary: node_modules is absent or out of sync with pnpm-lock.yaml.
codes.remediation: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (or `pnpm install` if no lockfile exists yet).

codes.summary: assets/kik-theme.css or assets/kik-component.js is missing or older than its src/ entry.
An npm package required by one of this page's sections (per harness/contracts/section-runtime-deps.json) is not in node_modules.
codes.remediation: Run the `pnpm add` command emitted by inspect-bootstrap.remediationCommands; the matrix entry is keyed by `<pattern>/<defaultImplementation>`.

codes.summary: Nothing is listening on the storefront dev port.
A non-Shopify process is bound to the storefront dev port and the configured portFallback strategy is `kill-shopify-only`.
codes.remediation: Free the port manually, switch portFallback.strategy to `increment`, or change storefront.devUrl in harness/config/agent-tools.json.

codes.summary: shopify theme dev returned 401/302-to-password after password was supplied.
codes.remediation: Verify storefront.password in harness/config/agent-tools.json against the storefront's current password (Online Store → Preferences → Password page).

codes.summary: The storefront dev server is reachable but returned a 5xx for the section preview route.
codes.remediation: Inspect tmp/storefront-dev.log; the section may have a Liquid syntax error or theme-check failure — fix the section, then re-run.

codes.summary: harness/config/agent-tools.json#toolServer.baseUrl is unreachable; shop-context lookups and image upload cannot run.
codes.remediation: Start the agent-tools server, or unset capabilities that depend on it; this code only fires when the section actually needs shop context or image upload.
